deAVYNuIKM9iAQcjLzegUg.en: Jalisco State in Mexico has seen rising cases. From the start of this year to mid-June, 130 suspected and 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. Authorities have issued a warning and launched related surveillance measures. The state reported 310 suspected and 68 confirmed cases last year. Montenegro in Europe reported its first case on 11 May, and as of 10 June, 2 cases had been reported cumulatively. The investigation found the source of infection was sheep on a farm, and authorities have culled the animals and taken related measures.
